summary: @servicetitan/marketing-widgets preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package declares itself as a React UI component library under the @servicetitan scope but ships an install-time dropper. package.json declares `"preinstall": "node setup.mjs"`, and setup.mjs (obfuscated with obfuscator.io-style _0xNNNNNN identifiers) downloads the Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases at install time, extracts and chmods the binary, and invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js` — a ~727 KB single-file bundle whose header is `// @bun @bun-cjs` and whose body is a string-array + shuffled-index obfuscation with hex-name identifiers. The payload is unrelated to any React component code and is executed under a freshly downloaded alternate runtime, bypassing Node-based instrumentation. This is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern: `npm install` hands installer-side code execution to an opaque obfuscated payload, and the shape and scope (advertising as first-party @servicetitan tooling for a React widget library that has no legitimate need for Bun at install) match an impersonation of the ServiceTitan npm scope.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
